# --- Supabase ---
# From your Supabase project's Settings -> API page.
SUPABASE_URL=https://<project-ref>.supabase.co
SUPABASE_ANON_KEY=
# Privileged, Row-Level-Security-bypassing key — server-only. NEVER send this
# to a mobile/web client; the client uses SUPABASE_ANON_KEY with its own
# Supabase client instead. See src/database/supabase.service.ts.
SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY=

# --- Auth ---
# No JWT secrets here: Supabase issues and verifies its own session tokens.
# The mobile/web client authenticates directly against Supabase
# (auth.signUp/signInWithPassword/refreshSession/signOut/etc. via
# @supabase/supabase-js) and sends the resulting access token to this API as
# `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. See src/auth/auth.module.ts and
# server/README.md. Supabase's hosted Auth sends its own verification/reset
# email directly — this variant's code never triggers the mail/ module.
